evals.prompt: Refactor this React component to make it easier to read and maintain. Keep behavior unchanged, reduce nesting, and follow the existing project style.
evals.expected_output: A targeted refactor that preserves behavior, reduces JSX/control-flow complexity, and reports verification.

evals.prompt: Ce fichier devient difficile à maintenir. Améliore l'indentation, simplifie les conditions et rends le code plus lisible sans changer la logique métier.
evals.expected_output: Une modification minimale qui laisse la logique métier intacte, confie le formatage au formatter du repo, et explique les incertitudes éventuelles.

evals.prompt: Clean up this service so it can scale long-term. Avoid a big rewrite; focus on clearer names, fewer repeated blocks, and simpler error handling.
evals.expected_output: A small service-level cleanup with clearer structure, no unnecessary abstraction, and focused lint/test verification.
